headword: {陣中見舞|じんちゅうみま}い

definitions.gloss: morale visit; encouragement gift; visit to those working hard
definitions.explanation: A visit or gift given to encourage people in the midst of an intense effort, such as during an election campaign, a major project, or long working hours. Originally referred to visiting soldiers at their camp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{陣中見舞|じんちゅうみま}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: To deliver an encouragement gift to an election campaign office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{差|さ}し{入|い}れ→差し入れ：08294_sashiire⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{陣中見舞|じんちゅうみま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いった。
examples.english: I brought sweets as an encouragement gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{陣中見舞|じんちゅうみま}い⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{入|い}れた→差し入れる：06794_sashiireru⟧。
examples.english: The president brought boxed lunches as a morale-boosting gift for staff working late into the night.

notes: Originally a military term — {陣中|じんちゅう} means "in camp" and ⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧ means "a visit (to comfort or encourage)." In modern usage, it most commonly refers to gifts or visits to election campaign offices, but also applies to any group working intensely on a project or event. In election contexts, {陣中見舞|じんちゅうみま}い can include monetary gifts, food, or supplies. Note that political donations disguised as {陣中見舞|じんちゅうみま}い are subject to legal restrictions under Japanese election law.
